caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object that appears to be a lidded urn or goblet with a stem and a broad circular base. The object is drawn in grayscale pencil, with shading used to indicate curvature and dimensionality. The urn has a rounded body with two horizontal ridges, a narrow neck that widens at the rim, and a lid with two cylindrical handles or finials extending vertically from the top. The stem beneath the body flares outward at two points before connecting to a broad, tiered base that widens towards the bottom. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch of the same object, enclosed within a rectangular border, showing the outline and shape without detailed shading. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the artist’s signature is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Camphene Lamp
